problem.title: Calculate Digit Sum of A String

approaches.title: Repeated chunk-and-sum
approaches.summary: While the string is longer than k, split it into chunks of k digits, sum each chunk, and concatenate the sums for the next iteration. Swap buffers between rounds.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Build each chunk’s sum as a temporary string and append it to the output buffer.

revisions.commitComment: use write! macro to avoid creating temporary string
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 2243: use write! macro to avoid creating temporary string
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Use the write! macro to append each chunk’s sum directly to the output buffer, avoiding a temporary string.
